summary: Video conversion (B,G,R,x -> R,G,B,255 over full 640x400 via putImageData in DG_DrawFrame; frame count incremented after blit) and wall-clock DG_GetTicksMs are correct. DG_SleepMs now yields via Asyncify, capped at 100 ms, with an in_frame re-entry guard, so the page stays responsive and tic pacing comes from the engine. No blocking issues found against the video/time criteria.

findings.evidence: git diff HEAD~1 HEAD: adds KEYMAP/keydown handlers and DG_GetKey/dg_pop_key in platform/doomgeneric_wasm.c
findings.summary: Keyboard input was implemented in this task although it belongs to the later input gate; it is untested here and keys like Space/Escape get preventDefault. Harmless but out of scope.

findings.criterion: Robustness of timing (35 Hz) under Asyncify
findings.summary: Sleeping through setTimeout in TryRunTics can add up to ~4 ms+ latency per wait, and rAF callbacks arriving while suspended are dropped, so on a throttled rAF the rate relies on the engine catching up via I_GetTime; this passed the controller's check but has little margin evidence. Asyncify also enlarges the wasm and slows -O2 code somewhat.
